review:
Stripped right back: one symbol per spin, either a multiplier or a blank. A bonus symbol starts ten It's Alive!! Spins, where the reel count grows from one to two, then four linked reels.

More bonus symbols lead into Devour Spins, with +5 spins each and the best multiplier carried forward. Extreme volatility, 40,000x max and a hit rate under 10%. Pure risk – try it in demo.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
